role: development gate; not confirmatory paper evidence
scientific_question: Does runtime workflow state make model-action value more learnable than request and node information alone?

quality_labels.primary: model-identity-blinded median of three integer 0-4 judge ratings, normalized by /4
quality_labels.evaluator_failure: missing and blocks complete-matrix analysis; never map to zero

prediction_target: observed trajectory N4 delivered semantic quality as return-to-go for each observed node action

shuffled_state: state_aware with state permuted across tasks within outer-train node strata; 100 fixed-seed permutations

offline_policy.scope: one-step intervention conditional on behavior-policy state; not an end-to-end causal policy claim
offline_policy.primary_ope: cross-fitted doubly robust with known propensity 0.25

go_gate.co_primary_predictability: group-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of RequestOnly absolute error minus StateAware absolute error > 0
go_gate.co_primary_policy: group-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of DR(StateAware)-DR(RequestOnly) > 0
go_gate.mechanism_safety: DR(StateAware)-DR(ShuffledState) > 0 and mean N2-N4 state advantage > N1 state advantage
go_gate.decision: GO only if both co-primary gates and mechanism_safety pass; otherwise STOP complex state-aware routing without retuning

after_go: execute pre-existing 20-task internal holdout with paired policies
only then implement ProgRouter-style and SelectiveStateAware
after_stop: report heterogeneity-observability gap; do not add complex routers
confirmatory_requirement: A positive offline gate alone is insufficient. Paper-level causal claim requires fresh task-group isolated policy execution and paired group-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.
forbidden: semantic labels before 640 engineering audit passes
trajectory/node rows as independent bootstrap units
threshold or model retuning after OOF results
reserved C10 remaining-60 access during development
